channel.title: The Hockey News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hockey News (thehockeynews.com)

item.title: The NHL's Playoff Race Is About To Get Incredibly Fierce
item.description: The NHL is back in action Wednesday night. And in the Eastern and Western Conferences, the battle for a wild-card position will be fierce. Here's what that means for the next week and beyond.

item.title: More Power To The Maple Leafs If They Become Trade Deadline Buyers
item.description: Maple Leafs executive Keith Pelley's letter to season-ticket holders says the team will do what it takes to not only make the playoffs but take the next step. If that means being trade deadline buyers, then they're making the right choice.

item.title: NHL Rumor Roundup: Vincent Trocheck, Evander Kane And Rasmus Ristolainen Draw Interest In The Trade Market
item.description: Center Vincent Trocheck is speculated to be the next New York Rangers player on the move, while Canucks right winger Evander Kane and defenseman Rasmus Ristolainen resurface in the trade rumor mill.

item.title: Which PWHL Players Led Each Olympic Women's Hockey Team In Scoring?
item.description: As the PWHL resumes Thursday, we look at which players from the league put up the most points for their national squad at the Olympics in Milan.

item.title: With A Gold Medal, USA's Laila Edwards Enters A Special Club With Just Three Others
item.description: When the U.S. women's hockey team won its third-ever Olympic gold medal, Laila Edwards joined two former NHL stars and current PWHL star Sarah Nurse as the only Black players to win gold in Olympic hockey.

item.title: Stuart Skinner Emerges As Surprising Trade Candidate Amid Penguins' Playoff Push
item.description: Stuart Skinner is on a hot stretch with the Pittsburgh Penguins, which continue to push for a playoff spot despite losing Sidney Crosby for at least four weeks. After GM Kyle Dubas traded Brett Kulak, could Skinner be next?

item.title: NHL Waivers: Kraken And Blues Place Forwards On The Wire
item.description: Seattle Kraken left winger Tye Kartye and St. Louis Blues right winger Mathieu Joseph are on NHL waivers Thursday.

item.title: The Wraparound: What Is Joel Quenneville's Impact On The Anaheim Ducks?
item.description: Emma Lingan, Michael Augello and Jim Parsons discuss landing spots for Tyler Myers, the Maple Leafs' future, whether Juuse Saros can keep Nashville in the playoff race, Joel Quenneville's 1,000th win and much more.

item.title: Screen Shots: The Worst NHL Division, Canucks' Tyler Myers, And Remembering Jim 'Boomer' Gordon
item.description: Adam Proteau discusses the NHL's Pacific Division letting the Kraken, Ducks and Kings stay in the playoff race, the potential trade of a Vancouver Canucks veteran defenseman, and a terrible loss for the hockey community.

item.title: NHL Hot Seat Radar: Which GMs Need To Make Trades?
item.description: Some NHL GMs are facing pressure before the trade deadline, whether they're chasing the Stanley Cup or building for the long-term. Who's feeling the heat?
